sys_di_key.description:
Extract the invoice information from this document.
Return ONLY valid JSON. Do not include markdown, code fences, explanations, introductory text, or any content outside the JSON object.
Use exactly this structure:
{ "document_type": "invoice", "invoice_number": null, "invoice_date": null, "vendor": { "name": null, "gstin": null, "address": null, "email": null }, "purchase_order": null, "company_code": null, "currency": null, "net_amount": null, "tax_amount": null, "gross_amount": null, "payment_terms": null, "bill_to": null, "line_items": [ { "description": null, "quantity": null, "unit": null, "unit_price": null, "net_amount": null } ] }
Rules: - Return null when a value is not available. - Amounts and quantities must be numbers, not formatted strings. - Do not include currency symbols or thousands separators in numeric values. - Extract all available invoice line items. - Do not invent information. - Return valid JSON only.
